verses.quietTimePrompt: What temptation feels overwhelming? Thank God for His faithfulness and look for the way out He provides.

translations.NIV: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.
translations.ESV: And you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.
translations.MBB: At makikilala ninyo ang katotohanan, at ang katotohanan ang magpapalaya sa inyo.

verses.reflection: Freedom is not the absence of boundaries but the presence of truth — knowing the truth liberates from every form of bondage.
verses.quietTimePrompt: What lie has been holding you captive? Thank God that His truth can set you free from it.

translations.NIV: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.
translations.ESV: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.
translations.MBB: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.

verses.reflection: Power is given for a purpose — the Spirit's empowerment equips us to be witnesses, starting locally and extending globally.
verses.quietTimePrompt: Where is God sending you as a witness? Thank Him for the Spirit's power that equips you to go.

translations.NIV: If you declare with your mouth, 'Jesus is Lord,' and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
translations.ESV: If you declare with your mouth, 'Jesus is Lord,' and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
translations.MBB: If you declare with your mouth, 'Jesus is Lord,' and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

verses.reflection: Salvation involves both mouth and heart — outward confession and inward belief together secure the promise of salvation.
verses.quietTimePrompt: Have you declared Jesus as Lord with both your mouth and your heart? Thank God for the salvation He promises.

translations.NIV: For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God, and all are justified freely by his grace through the redemption that came by Christ Jesus.
translations.ESV: For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God, and are justified by his grace as a gift, through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus.
translations.MBB: Sapagkat ang lahat ay nagkasala at kulang sa kaluwalhatian ng Diyos, at sila ay inaring-ganap nang walang bayad sa pamamagitan ng kanyang biyaya sa pamamagitan ng pagtutubos na nasa kay Cristo Jesus.

verses.reflection: Universal sin is met by universal grace — the same 'all' that falls short is the 'all' that is justified freely through Christ.
verses.quietTimePrompt: Do you still feel you fall too short for grace? Thank God that His justification is free and covers all.

translations.NIV: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who comes to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who earnestly seek him.
translations.ESV: And without faith it is impossible to please him, for whoever would draw near to God must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who seek him.
translations.MBB: At kung wala ang pananampalataya ay imposibleng makalugod sa kanya, sapagkat ang sinumang lumalapit sa Diyos ay dapat na maniniwala na siya ay umiiral at na siya ay nagbibigay-gantimpala sa mga naghahanap sa kanya.

verses.reflection: Faith is both a belief in God's existence and a trust in His generosity — seeking Him earnestly is rewarded, not ignored.
verses.quietTimePrompt: Are you earnestly seeking God today? Thank Him for the promise that He rewards those who seek Him.
